rows.question: What does idempotent ingestion mean in this implementation?

rows.question: Why are deterministic chunk IDs important?
rows.answer: Deterministic chunk IDs are important because they allow for idempotent ingestion, meaning re-ingesting an unchanged document updates the existing record instead of creating another vector [data/docs/demo_rag_02.md:0], [data/docs/rag_design.md:0]. This is achieved by deriving chunk IDs from document identity, chunk position, and chunk text [data/docs/rag_design.md:0], [data/docs/rag_design.md:1].
